featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a great pleasure to write this review about Xtreme Car Detailing Studio, Mr. Manpreet and his team. In the beginning I was equally confused and skeptical to handover my brand new car to anybody outside the OEM. But after a call with Manpreet and subsequent meeting, I knew that am doing the right thing.

I recently had my new car protected with paint protection film (PPF) by Xtreme Car Detailing Studio, and I couldn't be happier with the results! From start to finish, the experience was outstanding. Manpreet and his team at Xtreme are knowledgeable, professional, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to walk me through the various options available, different PPF options, explaining each detail and helping me choose the best protection for my vehicle in the most cost-effective way.

The quality of the work is impressive—flawless installation with no visible seams or imperfections. They clearly have an eye for detail and a dedication to perfection. My car not only looks fantastic but is now fully protected from road debris and scratches. The peace of mind is invaluable!

On top of the great work, their after sales service was excellent. I kept nudging them for a few things, they never seemed stressed and helped me always with smiling faces. Scheduling was smooth, they kept me informed throughout the process, and delivered on time.

I highly recommend Xtreme Car Detailing Studio at Chembur to anyone looking for top-notch PPF, ceramic coating, polishing, genuine accessories, car spa / wash and any other detailing services. They truly exceeded my expectations!

Kudos to Manpreet (always accessible on phone) and team who will be at Chembur shop to always help you. All the best to him and his team!
